summary: Regression tested MINDPULSE AI after the mocked scorer was replaced by the trained two-stage RandomForest ML pipeline. Backend: 6/6 pytest cases pass (root, stressed profile -> Moderate/Severe Stress, healthy profile -> Healthy w/ stress<20, MongoDB persistence w/ feature_attributions list, 422 validation, /api/performance returning Accuracy 0.9475 / ROC-AUC 0.9949 / 4x4 integer confusion matrix / 'held-out test set' notice / regression & regression_per_target). Frontend: full E2E via Playwright — populate demo data, step 6, run multimodal assessment, /results shows 'Moderate Stress' with all 4 probability bars, /explainability shows attribution-1 (Sleep Quality 100%), /performance renders 'Trained model v1.0.0' badge with 94.75% and ROC-AUC, /history lists prior runs including newly created assessments with correct Depression/Anxiety/Stress score columns.

issues: History rows expose no data-testid (e.g. history-item-{id}) — impacts automated coverage but not user functionality. Detail navigation via arrow chevron works.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py root endpoint still advertises mode='demo-local-analysis' while /api/performance reports 'Trained model v1.0.0' — inconsistent branding, consider updating the root response to reflect the trained model.
AssessmentInput has defaults for every field so nearly any partial payload is accepted (200 OK). Consider making at least the core sensor inputs required to catch client bugs earlier.
App.js is a monolithic single-file UI — >700 line rule violated; splitting into per-page components (Overview, Assessment, Results, Explainability, Performance, History) would help maintainability.
History list items would benefit from data-testid="history-item-{id}" for testability.
test_credentials: N/A - no auth in this app
seed_data_creation: Assessments created via /api/assessments/analyze during tests (persist in MongoDB history).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live in /app/backend/tests/test_mindpulse_api.py and require REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL env var (source /app/frontend/.env). Trained model artifacts at /app/backend/models/*.joblib + model_meta.json. Demo profile in App.js yields 'Moderate Stress'; a fully healthy profile (sleep 5, social 5, smile 85, HR 65, HRV 85, GSR 2) yields 'Healthy' with stress <20. /api/performance returns Accuracy 0.9475 & ROC-AUC 0.9949.
